details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept that beacons to a callback host at install time. Its package.json declares a postinstall hook running "node beacon.cjs", and beacon.cjs POSTs a JSON body to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an "x-beacon-package" header. The reported fields are limited to the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory (__dirname), the working directory, and an npm/<node-version> user agent — no environment variables, credentials, tokens, or file contents are read or transmitted. index.js additionally triggers the same beacon when the module is required, and exports a no-op Proxy so that importing the name does not break a build. The package describes itself as an authorized dependency-confusion test that only reports that it was installed.
